title: Execute the one-way GA activation: admit the human GO_ACTIVATE binding, activate through cutover.activate, issue the first authoritative v2 command, flip the activation record to ACTIVE
description:
FILED BY architect-ac8532da 2026-08-28 as the SUCCESSOR of task-09008b4c (GA activation record), which was re-planned under the human's universal-unblock instruction to deliver the explicitly refusing slice: the GO_ACTIVATE binding admission (packages/benchmark/src/activation-binding.ts) and the honest NOT_ACTIVATED record (packages/benchmark/campaigns/task-09008b4cb39c4a15aa661540d20e9b9b/activation-record.json with its re-deriving checker). This row is the ACT itself and carries the original row's DoD-2/DoD-3 sentences unchanged. It is gated by construction on three things no agent may supply or skip:
1. task-e60b874b (Live legacy quiesce run against the real system) DONE with LIVE per-item evidence - the operator deferred it until the PR #3 remediation epic (epic-072d85be) closes (2026-08-27 ~17:35Z). The harness-only drill task-4e1fe696 does not discharge it.
2. A human-authored GO_ACTIVATE BINDING record on THIS row that `admitActivationBinding` admits: decision GO_ACTIVATE (distinct from the recorded GO_QUIESCE, comment-14cf36f3 on e60b874b), a HUMAN grant re-checked by core's checkHumanAuthority for gateId GO_ACTIVATE and this work ref, and the four exact generations (quiesceRecordSha256, importGenerationSha256, backupGenerationDigest, distributionManifestSha256) plus the one sourceCommit. The STANDING authorization (comment-c34269c9 on task-09008b4c; campaign-record.json:120 "binding is deferred") is refused by the admission with ACTIVATION_BINDING_GENERATION_UNBOUND and must never be reinterpreted as a binding.
3. The cutover activation tooling (CutoverAttempt reducer + daemon cutover.activate + v2 activation marker) from its prerequisite row, measured absent at HEAD 62d2eee2 (vocabulary names only: runtime-vocabulary.ts:17-18, :89-90).

Relaxing any of the three before it exists ships an activation without authority or without a quiesced legacy - that is the exact one-way defect the design (section 21 items 12-13) forbids; no rollback is in scope after the first v2 command. Original scope statement preserved: signed GA release and activation record for one exact commit/distribution/import generation; NOT in scope: automatic rollback, dual write, or an unscoped best-tool claim; owned paths: final release evidence and activation tooling only.
definitionOfDone: VERIFY-OR-BLOCK first, on disk and on the board: task-e60b874b is DONE with live (not harness) evidence; a human-authored GO_ACTIVATE binding record is on THIS row and `admitActivationBinding` returns ok:true on it (quote the admission output verbatim); the cutover tooling row is DONE and `git grep -n CutoverAttempt HEAD -- packages/core/src` is non-empty with a registered daemon cutover.activate handler. If any premise fails, report blocked naming it - relaxing this gate before the human binding exists opens a live-authority hole.

GO_ACTIVATE binds the verified quiesce/import/backup/distribution generation and is distinct from GO_QUIESCE: each bound generation is re-verified on disk immediately before activation and any drift is a block, never a re-bind.

First authoritative v2 command occurs only after atomic activation; legacy remains locked/readable - prove a legacy read succeeds and a legacy write refuses after activation, and record the first v2 command's identity from the durable command log.

The activation record is flipped from NOT_ACTIVATED to ACTIVE only by the cutover tooling's own transcript, the campaigns checker is extended to re-derive the ACTIVE state from that transcript, the ten gate families are re-run at the activation commit with the resolver's table recorded, and the release record permits only sentences the claim permit-list affirmatively allows at the reached rung; commit by explicit pathspec.
taskRails: Claims follow the benchmark permit-list; missing, partial, cross-basis, or unverifiable evidence is UNKNOWN, never PASS.
GO_QUIESCE and GO_ACTIVATE are separate human decisions. Keep evidence exact, reproducible, and scoped to one source commit. No agent may author, complete, or reinterpret the GO_ACTIVATE binding.
One-way act: if any sub-step refuses, stop, leave the system in its refused state and report; never improvise a recovery, rollback, or dual write.

implementationPlan.description: VERIFY-OR-BLOCK — THE THREE PREMISES, measured honestly; on any early claim the EXPECTED OUTCOME IS A STOP. Read-only, ONE moe.add_comment, `git rev-parse HEAD` quoted, greps unpiped with exit codes + positive control. (a) LIVE QUIESCE: task-e60b874b DONE with LIVE per-item evidence (its own DoD distinguishes live from the harness drill task-4e1fe696 — quote its completionSummary; a harness-only record does NOT pass). NOT DONE -> moe.report_blocked with blockedOnTaskIds [task-e60b874bac924a6b9c255cb8c924041f], citing the governor flip's own instruction and comment-77fa0f6e's scope paragraph; STOP — this is the designed exit, not a failure. (b) BINDING: a human-authored GO_ACTIVATE binding RECORD is on THIS row — decision GO_ACTIVATE, HUMAN grant (gateId GO_ACTIVATE, workRef task-09008b4cb39c4a15aa661540d20e9b9b), all FOUR generations as 64-hex (quiesceRecordSha256 from the live quiesce's durable record, importGenerationSha256, backupGenerationDigest, distributionManifestSha256) and one 40-hex sourceCommit. The transcribed token (comment-77fa0f6e) is INTENT, not the record — if only the token exists, request the full record from the operator via the governor channel and STOP; never assemble it yourself (rail 3). (c) TOOLING: `git grep -n 'cutover.activate' HEAD -- apps/daemon/src/daemon-command-registry.ts` EXIT 0; the activate service + attempt writer present; AND the ATTEMPT WALK is reachable — measure how the aggregate reaches ACTIVATE_APPROVED at this HEAD (the earlier-edges gap task-620953 recorded): quote which writers/operator steps exist for preview/admit_quiesce/begin/complete_quiesce/verify_import; if the walk cannot reach ACTIVATE_APPROVED, the stop names the exact missing edge. (d) porcelain; note foreign dirt.

ADMIT THE BINDING — no bytes authored, evidence only. Run `admitActivationBinding` (via a REPL-style probe composing the published @moe/benchmark export — probe deleted in the same command, porcelain proof) on the operator-posted record VERBATIM. REQUIRED: ok:true — quote the full admission output in a row comment, including the admitted generations tuple byte-for-byte. ANY refusal stops the row: ACTIVATION_BINDING_GENERATION_UNBOUND (record without digests — the standing-authorization class), DECISION_MISMATCH (a GO_QUIESCE grant presented — the fixed check order refuses on decision kind first), or a decideApprovalAuthority refusal (carried verbatim, its own code+layer). On refusal: report the exact code+layer to the governor channel and STOP — the operator repairs the record or does not; no agent edits it, ever.

PRE-ACT GENERATION RE-VERIFICATION (DoD-2) — immediately before the act, in the SAME session that will dispatch it. For each of the four admitted digests, recompute from the durable source through the PRODUCTION reader/serializer that owns it (quiesce record digest via the landed quiesce evidence serializer; import generation via the durable import-generation reader; backup + distribution via their landed producers — quote each command and value). Byte-compare against the admitted tuple. ANY drift -> BLOCK naming the drifted fact and both values; NEVER re-bind, never proceed on three-of-four. Also fold the CutoverAttempt aggregate through the production reader and quote its lifecycle — it must be ACTIVATE_APPROVED (the admit_activate_approval writer consumed THIS binding's decision); any other state stops with the fold verdict verbatim.

THE ONE-WAY ACT (DoD-3 first half). ONE `cutover.activate` dispatch through the PRODUCTION command registry (the registered kind — never the service function called directly; the registry's refusal path is part of the act's authority). Record verbatim: the dispatch identity (commandId), the decision outcome, and the durable events it committed (the ACTIVATE_APPROVED -> ACTIVE transition and the v2 activation marker, in ONE transaction per the handler's landed atomicity). IF THE DISPATCH REFUSES: leave the system in its refused state, quote the exact code+layer, report, STOP — no retry, no recovery, no second dispatch (rail 4). IF IT COMMITS: the system is one-way ACTIVE; proceed. Then DoD-3's proofs from the live system: a LEGACY READ succeeds (quote the command and result), a LEGACY WRITE refuses (quote the exact refusal), and the FIRST AUTHORITATIVE v2 COMMAND's identity is recorded from the durable command log (quote the log row — the command itself is whatever the operator's runbook names as first; if none is named, the minimal read-only v2 authority command, stated).

RECORD FLIP + CHECKER + GATES (DoD-4). (a) Extend the campaigns checker (packages/benchmark/campaigns/task-09008b4c.../) to RE-DERIVE the ACTIVE state from the cutover tooling's OWN durable transcript (the events committed in step 4) — the checker computes, never trusts a hand-written state; flip activation-record.json NOT_ACTIVATED -> ACTIVE only through that derivation. (b) Re-run the TEN GATE FAMILIES at the activation commit; record the resolver's table verbatim. (c) The release record admits ONLY sentences the benchmark claim permit-list affirmatively allows at the reached rung (pinned spec sha A62B9043...); anything missing/partial/cross-basis stays UNKNOWN — never promoted. (d) COMMIT by explicit pathspec of exactly the owned paths (checker + record + any transcript artifacts the checker reads); porcelain first; foreign dirt untouched. COMPLETION COMMENT: the activation commit sha, the dispatch identity, the four re-verified digests, the first-v2-command log row, the legacy read/write proof lines, the gate table, and the statement: 'the GA activation executed one-way under the operator's admitted GO_ACTIVATE binding; legacy is locked-readable; the activation record derives ACTIVE from the cutover transcript'. Name task-e60b874b (live quiesce), the binding comment-77fa0f6e, and the tooling rows (620953, b254847909, b8272ee0).

reopenReason: Still required; blocked rather than backlogged per human cleanup policy: one-way activation cannot proceed before the external live-quiesce row lands. Unblock only after e60 is DONE with live evidence.

comments.author: architect-c1a63707
comments.content:
ARCHITECT BLOCK ANALYSIS — DoD 1's verify-or-block gate FAILS ON ALL THREE PREMISES at HEAD e3d20791. This is a ONE-WAY GA activation with no rollback in scope (task rail 4), so I am recording each measurement in full rather than summarising.

METHOD NOTE: every grep below was run UNPIPED with its own exit code, plus a positive control, because `git grep ... | head` reports head's exit status and would have read as success. Positive control: `git grep -c "export" HEAD -- packages/core/src/index.ts` -> exit 0, 61 matches. The grep mechanism works, so the exit-1/zero-line results below are genuine absences, not a broken command.

=== PREMISE 1 FAILS — the live legacy quiesce has not run ===
task-e60b874b ("Live legacy quiesce run against the real system") is **PLANNING**, claimed by architect-a69740e0. It is not DONE and has no live per-item evidence.
Worse, its own gate is not close: the operator deferred that run until the PR #3 remediation epic closes (2026-08-27 ~17:35Z, per this row's description). epic-072d85bea56c4badb07b9356ae195a98 is **ACTIVE**, not closed — I have been planning rows inside it all session.
The harness-only drill task-4e1fe696 explicitly does NOT discharge this.

=== PREMISE 2 FAILS TWICE — no binding, and no admission function to judge one ===
(a) This row has **ZERO comments**. There is no human-authored GO_ACTIVATE binding record on it. DoD 1 requires `admitActivationBinding` to return ok:true on a binding record ON THIS ROW and for the output to be quoted verbatim; there is nothing to submit.
(b) The admission itself is not built: `git grep -n "admitActivationBinding" HEAD` -> exit 1, ZERO lines, and `git cat-file -e HEAD:packages/benchmark/src/activation-binding.ts` -> "does not exist in 'HEAD'". The function the gate names cannot be called at all.
Note the standing authorization (comment-c34269c9 on task-09008b4c; campaign-record.json:120 "binding is deferred") is NOT a binding — the admission is specified to refuse it with ACTIVATION_BINDING_GENERATION_UNBOUND, and this row's description forbids reinterpreting it as one. Task rail 3: no agent may author, complete, or reinterpret the GO_ACTIVATE binding. So premise 2 is not agent-satisfiable by construction; it requires a human decision distinct from the already-recorded GO_QUIESCE.

=== PREMISE 3 FAILS — the cutover tooling does not exist ===
- `git grep -n "CutoverAttempt" HEAD -- packages/core/src` -> exit 1, ZERO lines. DoD 1 requires this to be NON-empty.
- `git grep -n "cutover.activate" HEAD -- apps/daemon/src packages/core/src` -> exit 1, ZERO lines. No registered daemon handler.
The row's own description measured this absent at HEAD 62d2eee2 ("vocabulary names only"); it is still absent many commits later at e3d20791.

=== WHY I AM NOT PLANNING AROUND ANY OF THIS ===
DoD 1 states the consequence itself: "relaxing this gate before the human binding exists opens a live-authority hole." Task rail 4 makes it one-way — if any sub-step refuses, stop and leave the system refused; never improvise a recovery, rollback, or dual write. The description names the exact defect the design forbids (section 21 items 12-13): activating without authority or without a quiesced legacy.
A plan written now could only be speculative on all three premises, and the one premise a human owns (the GO_ACTIVATE binding) can never be supplied by me or by a worker. There is no smallest-working-slice here: the row IS the irreversible act, so there is no separable production-reachable piece to land early. This is the one shape where the DELIVERY BIAS rail's hard-block conditions apply squarely — proceeding would fabricate authority.

=== UNPARK CONDITIONS, all three mechanically checkable ===
1. task-e60b874b is DONE with live (not harness) per-item evidence — which itself waits on epic-072d85be closing.
2. `git grep -n "admitActivationBinding" HEAD` exits 0, AND a human-authored GO_ACTIVATE binding record exists as a comment on THIS row, AND that admission returns ok:true on it with the four generations (quiesceRecordSha256, importGenerationSha256, backupGenerationDigest, distributionManifestSha256) plus the one sourceCommit bound.
3. `git grep -n "CutoverAttempt" HEAD -- packages/core/src` exits 0 AND `git grep -n "cutover.activate" HEAD -- apps/daemon/src` exits 0.

ORDERING IS A SAFETY CONSTRAINT HERE, not paperwork: landing this row before all three hold ships a GA activation without authority or without a quiesced legacy, and nothing rolls it back.

No bytes authored. Nothing in this row's paths touched.

NOTE FOR THE GOVERNOR/HUMAN: this row was deliberately parked to BACKLOG on 2026-08-29 to keep it off the ~67min reaper and out of stale-block sweeps; it is now in PLANNING and was offered to a claim. comments.content:
HUMAN GO_ACTIVATE BINDING — operator authorization, recorded verbatim.

The operator typed, in the governor terminal session (governor-0134a004, Claude session 515e2f97, 2026-08-30 ~11:26Z), addressed to the governor watching this row:

    GO_ACTIVATE

Context establishing intent: the governor had parked this row at 10:18Z with the unpark condition "the operator posts the GO_ACTIVATE binding; a governor then flips to PLANNING," and had told the operator in the same terminal at ~11:25Z that the row "stays parked until you post the GO on the row." The operator's next message was the single token above. This comment is the transcription of that authorization, made by the governor as transport; the DECISION is the operator's, given explicitly and in the exact term of art this row's DoD names.

SCOPE OF THIS BINDING, stated so no seat over-reads it: it lifts the human-GO premise (DoD-1 premise b) for THIS row. It does NOT discharge premise (a): the live legacy quiesce (task-e60b874b) has not run and remains parked behind c289b8fb per the operator's separate deferral — GO_QUIESCE is a distinct authorization the operator has not given. Any plan's verify-or-block must still measure premise (a) honestly and stop if the quiesce has not completed, unless the operator separately and explicitly authorizes activation without it.

Governor action on this binding: row flips BLOCKED to PLANNING per the park's own unpark mechanics.

REJECTED — waiting to plan until the quiesce lands: the operator gave the GO word now; a landed playbook lets the act run the moment premises hold, with the dependsOn field enforcing the wait. REJECTED — agent-assembled binding record: rails forbid any agent authoring/completing/reinterpreting the binding; the OPERATOR posts the full record with the four digests once they exist; the worker only runs the admission on it and quotes the verdict. RETAINED — one-way discipline: every step's refusal path is stop-and-report; no recovery, rollback, or dual write anywhere in the plan.

PREMISE (c) IS CLOSED: the whole cutover chain landed — packages/core cutover reducer/contract; task-620953 (CutoverAttempt writer/fold reader), task-b254847909 (cutover-activate-service.ts + contracts under apps/daemon/src/cutover/), task-b8272ee0 (registration — daemon-command-registry.ts imports activateCutover at :6-7 and registers `cutover.activate`; the registry doc at :67 notes an unconfigured daemon still registers the kind and refuses dispatches). PREMISE (b) IS INTENT-ONLY TODAY: the operator's GO_ACTIVATE token (transcribed comment-77fa0f6e) lifts the human-GO premise, but an ADMISSIBLE binding record needs the four exact generation digests + sourceCommit, and `quiesceRecordSha256` can only exist after the LIVE quiesce runs — admitActivationBinding refuses a digest-less record with ACTIVATION_BINDING_GENERATION_UNBOUND by design (the standing-authorization precedent, comment-c34269c9: permission to proceed when the evidence exists is not the evidence). planningNotes.risks: RISK 1 — the one-way property: after a successful cutover.activate there is NO rollback (design 21.12-13; ACTIVE is terminal, no abort edge out). Every pre-act step is therefore a REFUSAL OPPORTUNITY the plan preserves: admission, generation re-verification, attempt-state fold — each stops the act, none is retried-around. RISK 2 — generation drift between binding and act: DoD-2 says re-verify each bound digest on disk IMMEDIATELY before activation; drift is a BLOCK, never a re-bind — a re-bind would be an agent reinterpreting the human decision. RISK 3 — the four earlier cutover edges (preview/admit_quiesce/begin/complete/verify_import) need daemon writers or operator-driven equivalents to walk the attempt to ACTIVATE_APPROVED before cutover.activate can accept; task-620953's completion recorded that gap — step 1 must measure what landed since and, if the walk is still impossible, the stop names it precisely (it is part of premise-(c) reachability, not a new row to file from this row). RISK 4 — the live act touches the REAL system: the plan's execution steps run only under a claim taken AFTER e60b874b is DONE; any earlier claim exits at step 1 with report_blocked. RISK 5 — evidence discipline: the ten gate families re-run at the ACTIVATION COMMIT, the resolver table recorded, and the release record admits only permit-listed sentences — UNKNOWN never becomes PASS.
